**Position Overview**

Autodesk is seeking a dynamic Vice President of Engineering to lead the global engineering organization responsible for the design and simulation capabilities of Autodesk Fusion. Fusion is used by designers and manufacturers worldwide to bring innovative products to life, and the engineering team behind it has built a trusted platform that customers rely on every day.

This role will lead the next chapter of Fusion's engineering evolution. Over the next three years, you will guide the organization through a strategic transformation by embedding Artificial Intelligence (AI)-native development, cloud-native architecture, and continuous delivery into the engineering operating model while continuing to deliver the product roadmap our customers expect. The objective is to significantly accelerate product innovation and roadmap execution with AI as a key enabler.

Based in Pune, India, this role leads a global engineering organization distributed across Asia, Europe, and North America. Reporting to the Vice President of Design, you will partner closely with Product Management, Experience Design, Architecture, and Go-to-Market leadership to shape the future of Autodesk Fusion.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the transformation of the engineering organization by embedding Artificial Intelligence (AI) throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements discovery through design, development, testing, deployment, and operations
* Evolve engineering practices by enabling teams to leverage AI effectively while maintaining rigorous engineering standards, validation processes, and technical oversight
* Build quality, reliability, and observability into the platform through automation, instrumentation, continuous verification, and production monitoring
* Advance the platform architecture by promoting modular design, well-defined interfaces, strong abstraction boundaries, and loosely coupled systems
* Enable independent engineering teams to deliver continuously across a portfolio of composable platform capabilities
* Lead organizational transformation with clarity, urgency, and strong execution while ensuring continuous delivery of customer value
* Lead global engineering, Quality Assurance, and engineering support organizations responsible for Autodesk Fusion Design and Simulation
* Develop engineering strategies and organizational objectives aligned with Autodesk's product vision and business priorities

* Lead the recruitment, development, and retention of world-class engineering talent across multiple global regions
* Partner closely with Product Management, Experience Design, and Architecture leadership to deliver innovative customer experiences

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and regional Autodesk teams to strengthen customer relationships and expand Autodesk's presence within the Indian market
* Represent Autodesk at industry conferences, customer events, and professional communities
* Monitor industry trends across engineering, manufacturing, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and cloud technologies to identify strategic opportunities

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success leading large-scale engineering transformation initiatives while providing deep technical leadership
* Extensive experience with cloud-native software architecture, Software as a Service (SaaS) platforms, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled software engineering
* Strong technical credibility to guide architectural direction and engineering strategy across large organizations
* Deep understanding of engineering software and the importance of customer workflows, computational performance, scalability, and precision
* Proven ability to evaluate emerging AI technologies and lead organizations through significant technological transformation
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations across multiple geographic regions through periods of significant organizational change
* Outstanding communication, collaboration, and executive leadership skills with the ability to build trust across cultures and disciplines
* Experience collaborating effectively across multiple time zones, including sustained partnership with North America-based leadership teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading engineering organizations within multinational technology companies
* Familiarity with Autodesk products, platforms, and Design and Manufacturing solutions
* Knowledge of the Indian manufacturing industry and its digital transformation landscape
* Master of Business Administration (MBA) or another advanced business degree
* Experience leading Artificial Intelligence (AI)-driven engineering transformation initiatives at enterprise scale

**The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is an inspiring technology executive who combines visionary leadership, deep engineering expertise, and a passion for innovation to transform how world-class software is built while delivering exceptional customer outcomes

* Demonstrates a compelling vision for the future of software engineering and successfully leads organizations through large-scale technology transformation
* Combines deep technical expertise with strategic business acumen to make informed decisions that balance innovation, quality, scalability, and customer value
* Inspires engineering teams to embrace Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled development while maintaining the highest standards of software quality and engineering excellence
* Builds high-performing global engineering organizations by developing talent, empowering leaders, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous learning
* Drives architectural excellence by promoting modern engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, automation, and operational excellence
* Influences executive stakeholders and builds strong partnerships across Product Management, Design, Sales, Marketing, and customer organizations
* Anticipates emerging industry trends and translates technological advancements into long-term competitive advantage
* Demonstrates exceptional communication skills with the ability to engage engineers, executives, customers, and industry leaders

* Leads with integrity, resilience, and a growth mindset while creating an inclusive culture where teams can innovate and thrive

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

title: Technical Lead, Delivery and Pre-Sales
description:
**You will turn client conversations into software that ships on estimate**

MTechZilla is a custom software development company with a team of 30+ in Pune. We build web, mobile, cloud and AI products for startups and businesses, primarily in the US and Europe, and have delivered 40+ products.

You will be the technical person in the room with our clients. You join discovery calls, design the solution, write the estimate behind our quotation, turn requirements into stories developers can build from, and stay with the project until release.

You will run 5 to 6 client projects at a time, each with a team of 3 to 6 developers per project. Expect about 20% of your week on architecture and code review, and 80% on client work, requirements, estimates, and delivery.

**Who this role fits**

This role fits you if:

* You are a senior developer or tech lead at a software agency or startup.
* You already estimate work and talk to clients directly.
* You want to own a project from the first call to release, and not only the code.

It does not fit you if:

* You want to write code for most of the week.
* You manage through team leads or a project management office.
* You have not reviewed code or written an estimate yourself in the last two years.

**What you will be responsible for**

**Design solutions and write estimates for new leads**

Every quotation we send depends on this part of the role.

* Join discovery and pre-sales calls as the technical lead.
* Answer a lead's technical questions on calls and in writing, so the growth team does not have to wait for a developer.
* Design the solution: architecture, tech stack, integrations and hosting approach.
* Break requirements into features and tasks, and estimate effort and timelines.
* Complete the technical sections of our quotation: scope, assumptions, exclusions, team composition, milestones and timeline.
* Estimate AWS and third-party costs where relevant.
* Split a product into phases that fit the client's budget.
* Review SOWs for technical and delivery feasibility before they are signed.

**Turn client briefs into stories developers can build from**

* Run discovery and requirements sessions with clients.
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that developers can build from without guesswork.
* Prioritize features by business value, effort and risk.
* Answer your clients' technical questions during the project: architecture, feasibility, timelines and costs.
* When you do not have the answer, find it and reply within one working day.

**Keep projects on scope, on time and on budget**

* Own delivery of your projects from kickoff to release and handover.
* Compare time spent against the estimate every week, and raise overruns early.
* Turn scope changes into approved, billable change orders.
* Track risks and blockers every week, and act on them before they reach the client.
* Run sprint demos and status reviews, and tell clients about risks before dates are missed.
* Coordinate with QA so every release is tested before a client sees it.
* Send a one-page weekly report to leadership for each project: status, budget, top risk and decisions needed.
* Spot follow-on work in existing projects, propose it to the client, and bring it to the growth team to close.

**Lead the developers on your projects**

* Set priorities for your project teams. Changes to who works on your projects go through you.
* Review architecture and code on critical projects.
* Run stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, and follow through on action items.
* Run projects in Jira and keep requirements, architecture decisions, and handover notes in Confluence.

**What you will grow into**

After your first six months, you will take on more of how we work:

* A reusable estimation model built from past projects, so quotes get faster and more accurate.
* Our standards for documentation, sprints, QA gates, and releases.
* Hiring and interviews for the engineering team.

**Technical skills you need**

You need to design a system, judge whether a developer's estimate is realistic, and hold a technical conversation with a client's CTO.

* At least 3 years as a hands-on software engineer.
* Working knowledge of our stack, deep enough to design and review solutions: React and Next.js, React Native, Node.js and AWS.
* System design: APIs, databases, authentication, scaling, and third-party integrations such as payments, maps and notifications.
* Security and data protection basics, including GDPR for European clients.
* GitHub or GitLab workflows, CI/CD and architecture diagrams.

**Experience and qualifications**

Required

* 5 to 7 years of total experience, including at least 3 years as a hands-on software
* engineer.
* Experience estimating software projects, with one example of an estimate compared
* to actual delivery.
* Experience leading a project or a small engineering team.
* Experience working directly with clients, ideally in the US or Europe.
* Clear written English for estimates, user stories and status reports.
* Working use of Jira or a similar tool.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field, or
* equivalent experience.

Preferred

* Experience at a software services company or agency, especially on fixed-price
* projects.
* Experience running more than one project at the same time.
* Experience building or integrating AI and LLM features.
* Exposure to IoT or connected products in e-mobility, energy, industrial equipment or
* logistics.
* Daily use of Claude or other AI tools in your work

**What success looks like in your first 6 months**

* Quotations and estimates for new leads go out without the CEO filling in technical or
* timeline details.
* The technical section of a quotation goes out within three working days of the
* discovery call.
* Your projects ship within 10% of their estimated timeline and budget.
* Every client gets a weekly status update, and escalations to the CEO are the
* exception.
* Every active project has documentation in Confluence that another team member
* could pick up and work from.
* We have a first version of an estimation model built from past projects.

Pay: From ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

description:
**About Us**

Founded in 2019, LEOR is a premium skin, hair and body clinic in Pune, with centres in Koregaon Park and Aundh. We believe beauty lies in the radiance, not in fairness and that the smallest details shape the experience. Every treatment is delivered with world-class technology and highly-skilled doctors, uncompromising on quality and safety. We are now looking for an exceptional clinic sales manager to join us.

**About The Role**

As Clinic Sales Manager at LEOR Clinic, you will own the sales performance of the centre. You will lead the relationship managers, close high-value treatment programmes alongside the doctors, and grow revenue from both new and existing clients, with every sale backed by an experience that matches the standard of the clinical work.

**Job Title:** Clinic Sales Manager

**Location:** Pune (Koregaon Park or Aundh)

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Sales and Revenue**

* Own the centre's targets for conversions, collections and revenue, and track them by month, week and day.
* Lead high-value consultations alongside the doctors and close premium treatment programmes.
* Drive cross-sell and up-sell across services and products, and make sure clients redeem the sessions and packages they have bought.

**2. Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach and motivate the relationship managers to meet their individual targets.
* Break the centre target down by person and review each team member's scorecard daily and weekly.
* Train the team on treatments, pricing, objection handling and the LEOR Clinic consultation standard.

**3. Client Growth and Retention**

* Grow revenue from existing clients through renewals, upgrades and referrals, and bring lapsed clients back.
* Work closely with the pre-sale team so that booked appointments show up and convert.
* Resolve escalated client concerns quickly and protect the LEOR Clinic experience from arrival to departure.

**4. Reporting and Controls**

* Ensure every consultation, treatment plan and payment is recorded accurately in the clinic CRM.
* Keep billing, discounts and collections accurate and within approved limits.
* Report daily on footfall, conversions and collections, and present the centre's numbers in the weekly and monthly sales reviews.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline. An MBA or a qualification in management, hospitality or life sciences is an advantage.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in client-facing sales, including at least 2 years leading a sales team, preferably in aesthetics, dermatology, healthcare, wellness, luxury retail or hospitality.

**Required Skills**

* A proven track record of meeting sales targets in a premium, consultative setting.
* Strong consultative selling and closing skills for high-value treatment programmes.
* The leadership to coach a team and hold every member accountable to target.
* Excellent communication in English and Hindi, Marathi preferred, with the presence to hold a premium conversation.
* Comfort with CRM systems, billing, sales data and daily reporting.

**Why LEOR Clinic**

* A premium environment where the client experience is treated as seriously as the clinical outcome.
* A wide portfolio of advanced treatments and a strong medical team behind everything you recommend.
* Clear targets with an incentive structure that rewards performance.
* Growth into centre leadership as LEOR Clinic grows.

**How to Apply:**

* Send your CV to the LEOR Clinic team for review at hr@leorclinic.com

You'll work closely with the founding team and play an important role in establishing Herbal Pouch across Pune and surrounding markets.

* Conduct in-person meetings, product demonstrations, and sales pitches.
* Convert prospective businesses into active customers and retail partners.
* Generate purchase orders and consistently achieve monthly sales targets.

**2. Retail & Distribution Expansion**

* Onboard new retail outlets, distributors, and institutional partners.
* Negotiate commercial terms, margins, and order quantities within company guidelines.
* Build a strong pipeline of prospective business accounts.

**3. Relationship & Account Management**

* Maintain relationships with existing retail and institutional customers.
* Conduct regular follow-ups to generate repeat orders.
* Monitor product availability, replenishment requirements, and partner feedback.
* Address partner queries and coordinate with internal teams for smooth order fulfilment.

**4. Field Sales Execution & Reporting**

* Plan and conduct daily market visits and sales meetings.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, meetings, orders, and follow-ups.
* Track sales performance and share regular progress updates.
* Gather market intelligence, competitor insights, and customer feedback to identify growth opportunities.

Who We're Looking For

* 0–3 years of experience in field sales, B2B sales, retail distribution, FMCG, pharmaceuticals, or business development.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills, confidence, and a strong willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
* Comfortable travelling locally and meeting potential customers in person.

* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable handling rejection.
* Ability to independently plan daily visits, manage leads, and follow through on commitments.
* Good communication skills in Hindi, Marathi, and basic English.

What We're Offering

* **Competitive salary:** Starting from ₹25,000/month, with higher compensation for experienced candidates.
* **Performance incentives:** Additional earning opportunities linked to sales performance.
* **Direct founder exposure:** Work closely with the founding team and contribute to the brand's expansion strategy.

title: Data Entry Executive
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Data Entry Executive with e-commerce and AI skills to join our growing team in India. The candidate will be responsible for entering, updating, organizing, and maintaining product data, customer records, supplier details, spreadsheets, digital files, and information on the company’s e-commerce website.

The candidate will regularly upload new products, update existing listings, make website content changes, organize product categories, manage images and specifications, and ensure that all online product information is complete, accurate, and professionally presented.

The ideal candidate should be accurate, organized, consistent, and able to follow instructions carefully. They should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, organize information, prepare product content, identify errors, and complete routine administrative and e-commerce tasks more efficiently.

AI tools should be used to support the work, but all information must be manually reviewed and verified before publishing.

Key Responsibilities

**Data Entry:** Enter and update product details, prices, descriptions, specifications, customer information, supplier records, and other company data accurately.

**E-Commerce Product Uploads:** Upload new products to the company’s e-commerce website, including product names, descriptions, prices, specifications, dimensions, materials, colours, finishes, images, categories, and other required information.

**Product Listing Management:** Update and maintain existing product listings, correct inaccurate information, replace images, revise descriptions, add new specifications, and ensure all listings remain complete and up to date.

**Website Content Updates:** Make routine changes to website content, product pages, categories, collections, banners, links, downloadable documents, and other sections when required.

**Product Categories and Variations:** Organize products under the correct categories and manage product options or variations such as size, colour, finish, material, configuration, and model.

**Pricing and Availability Updates:** Update product prices, promotional information, availability, stock status, and other commercial details based on approved instructions.

**Product Image Management:** Upload, rename, resize, organize, replace, and arrange product images to ensure they are displayed clearly and correctly on the website.

**Website Quality Checking:** Review published product pages to confirm that images, descriptions, prices, specifications, variations, links, and page layouts are displaying correctly.

**Excel and Google Sheets:** Maintain spreadsheets, organize information, check records for accuracy, apply formulas, remove duplicate entries, and ensure data is formatted correctly.

**AI-Assisted Data Processing:** Use AI tools to help organize large amounts of information, structure unformatted data, summarize documents, categorize records, and convert rough information into clear and usable formats.

**AI-Assisted Product Content:** Use AI tools to help prepare, rewrite, shorten, standardize, or improve product names, descriptions, specifications, and website content while maintaining factual and technical accuracy.

**Data Cleaning and Standardization:** Use spreadsheet functions and AI-assisted tools to identify missing information, formatting inconsistencies, duplicate entries, spelling errors, and incorrect data.

**Basic E-Commerce SEO Support:** Assist with preparing clear product titles, descriptions, categories, image names, page information, and search-friendly content based on company guidelines.

**File Management:** Organize digital files, folders, product images, documents, spreadsheets, and internal records in a clear and structured manner.

**Document Processing:** Extract and organize information from PDFs, quotations, supplier documents, catalogues, images, and other files using appropriate digital and AI tools.

**Administrative Support:**  
Support the office, sales, marketing, purchasing, and operations teams with basic back-office, website, and administrative tasks.

**Quality Checking:** Review all entered, uploaded, and AI-generated information carefully to identify errors, correct mistakes, and ensure records are complete and accurate.

**AI Output Verification:** Check all AI-generated content before use. Ensure that product specifications, dimensions, prices, customer details, supplier information, and technical data have not been incorrectly changed or invented.

**Data Confidentiality:** Handle customer, supplier, pricing, product, website, and company information responsibly and maintain confidentiality at all times.

Requirements & Qualifications

**Experience:** Minimum 4–5 years of experience in data entry, e-commerce operations, website product uploading, back-office operations, administration, product data management, or a similar role.

**E-Commerce Experience:** Previous experience uploading and maintaining products on an e-commerce website or content management system is preferred.

**Product Data Skills:** Ability to understand and organize product names, descriptions, dimensions, specifications, materials, finishes, images, prices, categories, and variations.

**Data Entry Skills:** Good typing speed, strong accuracy, and the ability to enter and update large amounts of information consistently.

**Excel and Google Sheets:** Good working knowledge of spreadsheets, including formatting, sorting, filtering, formulas, data validation, duplicate removal, and basic data analysis.

**AI Skills:** Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar platforms to organize information, improve written content, assist with spreadsheet work, and increase productivity.

**AI Prompting:** Ability to write clear instructions and prompts to generate accurate, structured, and relevant outputs.

**English Requirement:** Excellent English reading, writing, verbal communication, and comprehension skills are required. The candidate must be able to understand product information, website instructions, internal processes, and written feedback and communicate professionally in English.

**Attention to Detail:** Must be able to check information carefully, identify errors, compare website listings against original sources, and avoid mistakes.

**Organization:** Must be able to maintain clean records, structured folders, properly named files, accurately updated spreadsheets, and organized website listings.

**Technology:** Must be comfortable learning new e-commerce platforms, content management systems, company software, AI tools, and digital workflows.

**Attitude:** Reliable, punctual, focused, responsible, willing to learn, and able to follow instructions and complete tasks within agreed timelines.

**Why Join Us?**

Stable office-based role with opportunities for professional growth.

Opportunity to gain practical experience in e-commerce website management, product uploading, data entry, and digital operations.

Opportunity to develop practical experience using AI tools in product management, website content, and business operations.

Supportive team environment where accuracy, efficiency, consistency, communication, and responsibility are recognized.

Opportunity to work with product data and e-commerce operations for a growing office furniture company.

description:
**SALES MANAGER – B2B MEDIA & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT**

**Position**  
Sales Manager – B2B Media & Business Development

**Experience**: 5+ Years  
**Department**: Sales & Business Development  
**Location**  
Pune, Maharashtra

**Work Mode**  
On-site, Monday to Friday | WFH – Saturday

**Employment Type**: Full-time

**Working Hours**: 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM

**Compensation**: INR 60,000 – ₹70,000 per month\*

**ABOUT MACHINE MAKER**  
Machine Maker (an initiative of Mart Infomedia Private Limited) is a B2B media platform focused on the manufacturing sector, connecting manufacturers, industry professionals, SMEs, technology providers and other stakeholders. Through print, digital, visual storytelling and on-ground events, Machine Maker highlights industry trends, innovations, business developments and the people shaping Indian manufacturing.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
The Sales Manager – B2B Media & Business Development will drive revenue growth by acquiring new clients, expanding existing accounts and developing integrated media partnerships across Machine Maker’s print, digital, video, social media, webinar, event and exhibition platforms. The role requires a consultative sales approach: understanding a client’s marketing and business objectives, translating them into relevant media solutions, and owning the commercial process from prospecting to closure, execution coordination, renewal and collections. The Manager will also strengthen sales discipline, reporting and team performance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**• Revenue Strategy & Target Ownership:** Develop and execute monthly, quarterly and annual sales plans; own assigned revenue targets, budgets, forecasts and conversion goals across the media portfolio.

**• New Business Development:** Build a strong prospect pipeline through research, outbound calls, email, LinkedIn, referrals, networking, industry databases, trade fairs and manufacturing events. Identify decision-makers in marketing, corporate communications, business leadership and product divisions.

**• B2B Media & Advertising Sales:** Pitch and sell relevant solutions including print advertising, digital display and website visibility, sponsored articles and branded content, video interviews / brand films, social media campaigns, newsletters, webinars, event partnerships, exhibition visibility and integrated packages, as applicable to the current portfolio.

**• Industrial Market Coverage:** Develop accounts across manufacturing and allied sectors such as machine tools, automation, robotics, engineering, industrial components, cutting tools, metrology, material handling, industrial software, electronics, automotive, aerospace, energy and manufacturing services.

**• Consultative Selling & Proposals:** Understand client objectives, target audiences, campaign budgets and timelines. Prepare tailored media plans, proposals, presentations, quotations, sponsorship packages and commercial recommendations that demonstrate value and expected deliverables.

**• Negotiation & Deal Closure:** Lead commercial discussions, negotiate rates and terms within approved pricing and discount policies, follow up systematically, close business and ensure written confirmation / purchase orders or insertion orders are secured.

**• Account Management & Retention:** Own relationships with assigned clients and agencies; conduct regular reviews, identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, secure renewals and build long-term strategic partnerships.

**• Campaign Handover & Delivery:** Coordinate with editorial, digital, design, video, social media, production and event teams to communicate approved scope, specifications, timelines and client expectations. Monitor delivery against commitments and escalate risks early.

**• Client Servicing & Reporting:** Ensure timely client communication, campaign updates, proof of publication / delivery and post-campaign reports where relevant. Capture feedback and resolve service issues in coordination with internal teams.

**• Sales Operations & CRM:** Maintain accurate CRM / lead tracker records, contact history, meeting notes, proposal status, deal value, probability, next action and closure dates. Keep pipeline data current and submit weekly and monthly reports.

**• Market Intelligence:** Track competitor offerings, media rates, industry events, marketing trends and client activity. Share market insights and product feedback to improve Machine Maker’s commercial offerings.

**• Team Leadership & Collaboration:** Guide and support sales executives where applicable, review activity and pipeline quality, coach on pitches and follow-ups, share best practices and foster accountability for collective targets.

**• Invoicing & Collections:** Coordinate with accounts and clients on billing milestones, payment follow-ups and outstanding receivables; support timely collections in line with company policy.

**• Industry Representation:** Represent Machine Maker professionally at exhibitions, conferences, customer visits, networking forums and industry associations; build relationships with senior stakeholders across the manufacturing ecosystem.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

**•** Strong B2B sales, consultative selling, business development and revenue ownership capabilities.

**•** Excellent communication, presentation, pitching, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

**•** Ability to prospect independently, reach senior decision-makers and convert leads into paying accounts.

**•** Understanding of media sales, advertising formats, sponsorships, branded content and integrated marketing solutions.

**•** Commercial acumen, including proposal development, pricing, margin awareness, forecasting and deal management.

**•** Strong account-management skills with the ability to retain, grow and renew client relationships.

**•** Working knowledge of CRM systems or structured sales trackers, MS Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / presentation tools.

**•** Ability to interpret campaign briefs, coordinate cross-functional execution and manage multiple deadlines.

**•** Data-driven approach to pipeline reviews, sales reporting, conversion analysis and performance improvement.

**•** Self-motivated, organised, resilient and comfortable working in a target-driven environment with regular client meetings and industry travel.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

**•** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Mass Communication or a related discipline; an MBA / postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

**•** 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, media sales, advertising sales, publishing, sponsorship sales, events or business development.

**•** Prior experience selling to manufacturing, engineering, industrial technology or other enterprise B2B clients is strongly preferred.

**•** Experience managing key accounts, annual media plans, integrated campaigns, event sponsorships or high-value commercial partnerships.

**•** Prior experience mentoring or supervising sales executives is an advantage.

**•** Existing relationships with manufacturing brands, marketing heads, advertising agencies or industry associations will be an added advantage.

**KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS (KPIS)**

**•** Achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.

**•** New client acquisition and revenue generated from new accounts.

**•** Qualified lead generation, meeting activity, proposal volume and lead-to-deal conversion rate.

**•** Revenue mix and sales across print, digital, video, branded content, events and sponsorship offerings.

**•** Average deal value, gross contribution / margin discipline and quality of commercial closures.

**•** Existing-client retention, renewal rate, repeat business, upsell and cross-sell revenue.

**•** Pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy and timely CRM / sales tracker updates.

**•** Timely campaign handover, client satisfaction and fulfilment of agreed deliverables.

**•** Timely invoicing coordination and collection of receivables.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

A commercially driven B2B sales professional who can confidently engage with business owners, marketing leaders and senior decision-makers in the manufacturing ecosystem. The candidate should combine a hunter’s mindset for new business with the discipline to manage accounts, forecast revenue and work collaboratively with internal teams to deliver measurable value to clients.

*\*Compensation budget is indicative and depends on relevant experience, capability and fit.*

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Provident Fund

* Have you independently handled monthly or quarterly sales revenue targets?

* Do you have experience selling advertising, digital marketing, branded content, video campaigns, or event sponsorship packages?

* Have you managed existing client accounts, renewals, upselling, and cross-selling?
* Have you supervised or mentored a sales team?
* Are you comfortable with client meetings, field visits, and industry exhibitions when required?

title: Associate Director - Data Operations
description:
**About Data Axle**

Data Axle Inc. has been an industry leader in data, marketing solutions, sales, and research for over 50 years in the USA. Data Axle has an established strategic global centre of excellence in Pune that delivers mission-critical data services to global customers through its proprietary cloud-based technology platform and proprietary business and consumer databases.

Data Axle India is recognized as a Great Place to Work. This prestigious designation reflects our commitment to fostering an exceptional workplace culture where employees can thrive, collaborate, and contribute to meaningful business outcomes.

**General Summary**

The **Associate Director – Data Operations** will provide strategic and operational leadership for data operations, quality, process excellence, and service delivery. The role will be responsible for driving operational performance, data quality, productivity, automation, continuous improvement, and scalable operating practices across data operations teams.

This position will serve as a key bridge between business leadership, operations, analytics, product, technology, and other cross-functional stakeholders. The Associate Director will establish operational frameworks, monitor business and productivity metrics, identify opportunities for process and technology optimization, and ensure delivery of high-quality data services aligned with business objectives.

The role requires a strong combination of **people leadership, operational management, analytical thinking, process transformation, stakeholder management, and technology orientation**.

**Essential Job Functions**

* **Strategic Operations Leadership**

* Define and execute the strategic direction for Data Operations in alignment with organizational and business objectives.
* Establish scalable operating models, governance frameworks, processes, and performance standards for data operations.
* Translate business priorities into actionable operational plans, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
* Partner with senior leadership to identify operational risks, opportunities, and areas for business improvement.

* **Data Operations & Quality Management**

* Oversee data collection, research, processing, validation, enrichment, and quality assurance activities.

* **Operational Excellence & Process Transformation**

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, productivity, cost effectiveness, and scalability.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives using process optimization, Lean/Six Sigma principles, automation, and technology.
* Evaluate existing workflows and develop improved current-state and future-state operating processes.
* Establish quality gates, controls, and standardized operating procedures across teams.
* Drive initiatives that reduce manual effort, cycle time, operational risk, and rework.

* **Automation, AI & Technology Enablement**

* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, analytics, and emerging technologies across Data Operations.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Analytics, and Technology teams to implement automation solutions.
* Evaluate operational processes for opportunities to improve productivity through intelligent automation and AI-enabled workflows.
* Support adoption of technology solutions that improve data quality, operational visibility, and decision-making.

* **Performance Management & Analytics**

* Establish and monitor operational KPIs, SLAs, productivity metrics, quality metrics, and service-performance indicators.
* Develop executive-level dashboards, reports, and operational reviews to provide visibility into business performance.
* Analyze trends and operational data to identify risks, bottlenecks, productivity opportunities, and improvement areas.
* Use data-driven insights to support resource planning, forecasting, prioritization, and management decisions.

* **People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop managers, team leads, analysts, and data operations professionals.
* Build high-performing teams through effective workforce planning, role definition, hiring, onboarding, coaching, and performance management.
* Establish clear objectives, accountability structures, and development plans for team members.
* Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Ensure appropriate resource allocation based on business priorities and operational demand.

* **Cross-Functional & Executive Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Operations, Analytics, Product, Engineering, Technology, Quality, and Business teams.
* Act as a senior point of contact for operational escalations and complex data-related issues.
* Communicate operational performance, risks, dependencies, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership.
* Translate complex operational and technology challenges into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
* Build strong relationships with global stakeholders and support alignment between business strategy and operational execution.

* **Risk, Compliance & Governance**

* Establish appropriate operational controls and governance mechanisms to ensure data integrity and process compliance.
* Identify operational, data, security, and delivery risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure adherence to organizational policies and applicable standards.
* Maintain appropriate documentation, controls, and governance processes across Data Operations.

* **Change & Transformation Management**

* Lead organizational change initiatives associated with new processes, technologies, operating models, and automation.
* Develop and communicate transformation roadmaps and ensure effective adoption across teams.
* Monitor implementation outcomes and continuously refine processes based on business and operational feedback.

**Supportive Job Functions**

* Support strategic and operational planning activities for the Data Operations organization.
* Participate in leadership reviews, business planning, and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Provide guidance on complex operational and data-related escalations.
* Support development of business cases for process improvement, automation, and technology investments.
* Participate in training, knowledge-sharing, and capability-building initiatives.
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned by management.

Requirements:

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong leadership and people-management capabilities with experience leading cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of data operations, data quality, data governance, and operational processes.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong understanding of operational KPIs, productivity measurement, and performance management.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities.
* Strong business acumen and ability to connect operational activities with business outcomes.
* Excellent executive communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Strong understanding of technology-enabled operations and digital transformation.
* Familiarity with SQL, databases, analytics, reporting, and data-management concepts.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other productivity/reporting tools.
* Experience working with Agile/Lean/Six Sigma or similar process-improvement methodologies is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively with global and cross-functional teams.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and operational excellence.

**Education, Experience, and Certification**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Advanced degree or professional certification in Management, Data, Technology, or Operations is preferred.
* **12+ years of progressive experience** in data operations, business operations, technology operations, analytics, transformation, or a related field.
* Significant experience in **people leadership, operational management, process transformation, and strategic program execution**.
* Experience managing large or cross-functional teams and multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience driving automation, productivity improvement, and operational efficiency.
* Experience working with senior leadership and global stakeholders.
* Experience in data-driven businesses, technology-enabled operations, research/data services, BFSI, or similar environments is preferred.

**CCTech**'s mission is to transform human life by the democratization of technology. We are a well established digital transformation company building the applications in the areas of CAD, CFD, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, 3D Webapps, Augmented Reality, Digital Twin, and other enterprise applications.

simulationHub is our flagship product and the manifestation of our vision. Currently, thousands of users use our CFD app in their upfront design process.

Our consulting division, with its partners such as Autodesk Forge, AWS and Azure, is helping the world's leading engineering organizations, many of which are Fortune 500 list of companies, in achieving digital supremacy.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As a Sales Executive you own a territory or industry segment and carry an individual revenue and pipeline target. You will run opportunities end-to-end — from qualification and solution discovery through proposal, commercial negotiation and closure — for custom engineering software, digital transformation consulting, Autodesk-ecosystem services and CCTech's AI platforms. You work closely with pre-sales, engineering and delivery teams, and act as the commercial counterpart to the customer's technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Pipeline & Demand Generation**

* Build and own a qualified pipeline for an assigned industry vertical, geography or account set.
* Execute targeted outbound campaigns (LinkedIn, email, calls, events) alongside marketing-generated and partner-generated leads.
* Qualify opportunities using a structured framework (BANT / MEDDIC or equivalent) and maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene.

**Opportunity Ownership**

* Conduct discovery with engineering, IT and business stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points and the business case.
* Work with pre-sales and technical teams to shape the solution, demo scope, PoC plan and effort estimate.
* Prepare and present proposals, SoWs, pricing and commercial terms; drive negotiation to closure.
* Manage the full sales cycle, including procurement, legal and security review cycles in enterprise accounts.
* Achieve and exceed assigned quarterly and annual revenue, bookings and pipeline-creation targets.

**Account & Partner Management**

* Grow revenue within existing accounts through cross-sell and upsell of services, platforms and subscriptions.
* Build multi-level relationships across design, engineering, manufacturing, IT and procurement functions.
* Coordinate with the Autodesk, AWS and Azure partner ecosystems for co-selling and joint opportunities.

**Market & International Exposure**

* Represent CCTech at industry events, trade shows and conferences in India and overseas.
* Support business development in international markets — North America, Europe, Middle East and APAC — including calls across time zones and periodic travel.
* Track competitor offerings, pricing patterns and market shifts; feed insight back into positioning and go-to-market plans.

**Operations**

* Maintain accurate CRM records, forecasts and activity logs; publish periodic pipeline and win/loss reporting.
* Contribute to proposals, case studies, capability decks and reusable sales collateral.
* Support and informally guide Jr. Sales Executives on research, outreach and qualification.Indicative Performance Measures

**Annual revenue / bookings achievement against quota**

* Qualified pipeline created (typically 3–4x of quota)
* Win rate and average deal size
* Sales cycle length and forecast accuracy
* New logo acquisition and existing-account growth

### **Requirements**

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–5 years of B2B sales or business development experience, preferably in engineering software, SaaS, IT services, CAD/CAE/PLM or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding individual sales targets.
* Sharp, commercially aware and proactive, with the ability to understand customer needs and learn technical offerings quickly.
* Ability to run technical discovery conversations and translate engineering capability into business outcomes and ROI.
* Experience selling to Manufacturing, AEC, Energy, Infrastructure or similar engineering-led industries.
* Strong proposal writing, presentation and commercial negotiation skills.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to the Autodesk ecosystem (AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor, ACC, APS, Forma, Tandem) or to CFD/simulation and PLM/PDM products.
* Experience selling custom software development or consulting engagements, not only licences.
* Understanding of AI/ML-enabled engineering products and their value proposition.
* Experience with partner/channel co-selling motions.

**Educational Background**

### **Benefits**

* Direct access to founders, technical architects and delivery leadership during the sales cycle.

**About Us**

**CCTech**'s mission is to transform human life by the democratization of technology. We are a well established digital transformation company building the applications in the areas of CAD, CFD, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, 3D Webapps, Augmented Reality, Digital Twin, and other enterprise applications.

simulationHub is our flagship product and the manifestation of our vision. Currently, thousands of users use our CFD app in their upfront design process.

Our consulting division, with its partners such as Autodesk Forge, AWS and Azure, is helping the world's leading engineering organizations, many of which are Fortune 500 list of companies, in achieving digital supremacy.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As a Sr. Sales Executive you own a significant revenue number and the strategy behind it. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise pursuits — custom engineering software programmes, digital transformation consulting, Autodesk-ecosystem engagements and AI platform subscriptions — often with long cycles and senior buyers (CXO, Plant Head, Chief Engineer, CIO, Head of Digital). Alongside your own quota, you mentor junior members of the sales team, own key partner relationships, and shape go-to-market strategy for your segment.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Revenue & Strategy Ownership
* Own and deliver an annual revenue / bookings quota for an assigned vertical, geography or strategic account portfolio.

* Navigate procurement, legal, infosec and compliance processes in large enterprises.
* Team Leadership & Mentoring
* Mentor and coach Jr. Sales Executives and Sales Executives on prospecting, qualification, discovery, proposal craft and negotiation.
* Review and raise the quality of outbound campaigns, proposals and client communication across the team.
* Help define and roll out sales process, playbooks, templates, qualification standards and CRM discipline.
* Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new sales team members. (Formal people-management responsibility may be added as the function scales.)
* Partner & Alliance Management
* Own and grow strategic alliance relationships — Autodesk, AWS, Azure and other technology partners.
* Drive co-selling, joint pipeline, partner-sourced opportunities, joint marketing initiatives and partner programme compliance.
* Position CCTech within partner ecosystems and competency programmes to maximise referral flow.
* International Markets & Industry Presence
* Lead business development in international markets — North America, Europe, Middle East and APAC — including regular calls across time zones and overseas travel.
* Represent CCTech at flagship industry events and conferences (e.g. industry expos, customer summits); run executive meetings on-site.
* Build CCTech's market presence through thought leadership content, webinars, customer references and case studies.
* Track competitive landscape, pricing trends and technology shifts; influence product and service roadmap with market feedback.
* Indicative Performance Measures
* Annual revenue / bookings achievement against quota
* New logo acquisition and strategic account growth
* Qualified pipeline created and partner-sourced pipeline
* Win rate on large/strategic pursuits and average deal size
* Forecast accuracy and sales cycle efficiency
* Team enablement outcomes — ramp time and performance of mentored sales team members

### **Requirements**

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–8 years of B2B / enterprise sales experience in engineering software, SaaS, IT services, CAD/CAE/PLM or digital transformation.
* Consistent record of carrying and achieving individual quotas, including large-ticket and multi-stakeholder deals.
* Sharp strategic and commercial thinking, strong problem-solving ability, and confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
* Proven experience selling into engineering-led industries — Manufacturing, AEC, Energy, Infrastructure, Semiconductor or Oil & Gas.
* Credibility with senior buyers; able to run a CXO conversation on business outcomes and an engineering conversation on workflows.
* Strong solution-selling, business-case building, commercial structuring and negotiation skills.
* Experience selling custom software development and consulting engagements, not only product licences.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or leading junior sales colleagues.
* Experience with partner/alliance-led selling motions.
* Advanced CRM, forecasting and sales analytics discipline.
* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills in English.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally; valid passport required.
* Good to Have
* Hands-on familiarity with the Autodesk ecosystem (Revit, AutoCAD, Inventor, ACC, APS, Forma, Tandem) or with CFD/simulation, PLM/PDM and digital twin solutions.
* Experience selling AI/ML-enabled engineering products or platforms.
* Existing network within target industries or the Autodesk/AWS/Azure partner ecosystem.
* Experience building a sales function or process from an early stage.  
    
  **Required Skills & Experience** **Educational Background**
* Preferred: Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline, particularly Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Production, Instrumentation or a related field.
* Also Considered: Graduates from other disciplines with a proven record of success in enterprise sales, strong commercial acumen, analytical ability and the ability to understand complex technical offerings.

### **Benefits**

* A senior, high-visibility role with direct exposure to the founding team (CEO, CBO, COO) and to delivery leadership.
* Ownership of strategy, not just execution — you shape how CCTech goes to market in your segment.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Sales Leader — Yavi Platform & Contract Intelligence

Position

Sales Leader

Company

Nimbusnext (Yavi.ai)

Location

India

Co-Founder & CEO

Experience

12–15 years

Markets

India (primary), US

About Nimbusnext and Yavi.ai

Nimbusnext builds Yavi.ai, an enterprise AI platform that turns an organization’s data and documents into faster decisions and measurable outcomes. Yavi Contract Intelligence, our solution for legal and business teams, helps enterprises review, analyze and manage contracts with speed and accuracy. We work with strategic technology partners including Microsoft, NVIDIA and Anthropic.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Sales Leader to amplify revenue for the Yavi platform and Yavi Contract Intelligence. Your mandate is clear: win and grow enterprise clients, with India as the primary market, while building a focused sales motion in the US. You will close strategic deals personally, build the team and work directly with the CEO.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Growth

* Own revenue targets for the Yavi platform and Yavi Contract Intelligence, with accurate forecasting and reporting.
* Grow annual recurring revenue through new logos, upsell, cross-sell and renewals.
* Set pricing and deal strategy with leadership to improve deal size and win rates.

Enterprise Client Acquisition

* Win enterprise clients for the Yavi platform across document-intensive industries.
* Sell Yavi Contract Intelligence to General Counsels, legal operations, procurement and finance leaders.
* Lead complex, consultative sales cycles: discovery, solution design, proposals, RFPs, negotiation and closure.
* Turn early customers into referenceable case studies and expansion accounts.

India Market Leadership (Primary Focus)

* Design and run the India go-to-market motion: target accounts, ideal customer profile, messaging and channels.
* Win large enterprises, corporate legal departments and leading law firms across key Indian metros.
* Build a strong India pipeline through outbound, partner co-selling, industry events and referrals.
* Hire and lead a high-performing India sales team of account executives, pre-sales and business development.

US Market and Partnerships

* Build a focused US sales motion for the Yavi platform and Contract Intelligence, with overlap with US hours as needed.
* Build co-selling motions with technology partners and resellers in India and the US.
* Bring customer and market insight back to product to shape the roadmap.

Qualifications

Required

* 12–15 years in B2B technology sales, with significant experience in SaaS or AI solution sales.
* Proven record of exceeding enterprise revenue targets and closing large, multi-stakeholder deals.
* Strong track record selling to Indian enterprises, with an established network of CXO-level buyers.
* Experience selling to US clients.
* Experience building and leading a sales team. Bachelor’s degree; an MBA is preferred.

Core Expertise

* Lead generation: building and running outbound and inbound programs that create qualified enterprise leads.
* Client interactions: confident, consultative engagement with CXOs, legal heads and business stakeholders.
* SaaS product demos: delivering compelling, outcome-focused demos of the Yavi platform and Contract Intelligence.
* CRM management: disciplined use of CRM tools (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho) for accounts, contacts and opportunities.
* Pipeline reporting: accurate forecasting, pipeline reviews and regular revenue reporting to leadership.
* Competitive analysis: tracking competing AI and contract-tech offerings and positioning Yavi to win.
* Value selling: building business cases around ROI, time saved and risk reduced, not features.
* Account-based planning: detailed plans for priority accounts, mapping stakeholders, needs and buying paths.
* Land-and-expand: winning a first use case, then growing across departments, products and renewals.

Preferred

* Strong advantage: Selling to the Legal industry: law firms, corporate legal departments or legal operations buyers.
* Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM), contract analytics or legal-tech solutions.
* Familiarity with generative AI, document intelligence or knowledge-management platforms.
* An established network of channel partners and system integrators in India.

What Success Looks Like

* A clear India sales playbook in place within the first 45 days.
* Consistent quarter-on-quarter revenue growth across the Yavi platform and Contract Intelligence.
* Marquee enterprise and Legal-sector clients won in India, with early wins in the US.
* A healthy India pipeline, early US traction and a sales team performing against targets.

Why Join Us

* Lead revenue for an AI platform and a focused Contract Intelligence solution at a key growth stage.
* Build the India sales engine from the ground up, with direct access to the CEO.
* Competitive compensation with strong performance-linked incentives.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note on your most significant enterprise win to Bhawana.Joshi@Nimbusnext.com. Please use the subject line “Application – Sales Leader”.

.  
  
  

The Coronary Vascular business is focused on advancing therapies that improve outcomes for patients with coronary artery disease and related cardiovascular conditions. The portfolio includes interventional technologies designed to support clinicians in complex procedures and help expand access to life-changing treatment options. This position is based in Pune, India and supports customers across Pune City territory. As a Sales Executive, you will drive commercial growth and market development for the Coronary Vascular portfolio within an assigned territory. This role partners closely with interventional cardiologists, cath lab teams, distributors, and other healthcare stakeholders to expand therapy adoption, achieve sales objectives, and deliver clinical and commercial support.

* Achieve territory sales objectives through effective execution of commercial strategies and account plans.

* Experience supporting healthcare professionals in hospital, operating room, or catheterization laboratory settings.
* Knowledge of cardiovascular therapies, clinical workflows, and healthcare stakeholder engagement.
Ability to travel approximately 30-35% within the assigned territory.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting interventional cardiology or coronary procedures in catheterization laboratory environments.
* Proven record of exceeding sales objectives in medical device or healthcare industries.
* Experience managing distributor networks and channel partnerships.
* Experience with multi-level stakeholder engagement across hospitals and healthcare systems.
Knowledge of coronary vascular products, therapies, and competitive market dynamics.

The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers.

**Tourism Business Operations & Business Development Manager – Job Description**

About the role

* **Company:** Vithu Tourism and Property Management India Pvt. Ltd. (Vithu Tours)

* **Position:** Operations & Business Manager

* **Location:** Hinjewadi, Pune (on-site, with travel as required)

* **Experience:** 4–8 years in travel, tourism or hospitality, including at least 2 years in operations

* **Reports to:** Founder / Director

Vithu Tours is an international travel company serving Indian travellers, with property management and car rental services alongside. We are looking for an Operations & Business Manager to run day-to-day travel operations smoothly and help grow the business. You will own the booking process from first enquiry to the client's safe return, manage our partner network, and work with the founder on branding, automation and growth.

Key responsibilities

* Manage the end-to-end booking process, from enquiry and quotation to confirmation, vouchers and post-trip follow-up.

* Create professional itineraries and quotations for domestic and international trips, with realistic routing, timings and pricing.

* Handle visa applications, passport validity checks, travel insurance and destination-wise document checklists.

* Coordinate forex requirements for clients where needed.

* Manage group departures: rooming lists, flight manifests, coach allocation and tour-manager briefings.

* Provide on-trip support and handle emergencies such as flight delays, missed connections, hotel issues, lost documents and medical situations.

* Send pre-departure briefings, collect post-trip feedback and resolve complaints quickly.

* Build and maintain relationships with hotels, resorts, airlines, DMCs, transport partners and contractors.

* Negotiate rates, allotments and cancellation terms, and keep a current contracted-rates sheet.

* Track partner service quality and replace under-performing vendors.

* Track client advances, balance payments, refunds and cancellations, and reconcile vendor payments.

* Monitor margin per booking and flag loss-making quotes before confirmation.

* Work with the accountant to apply GST and TCS on overseas tour packages correctly.

* Maintain accurate client records, booking files and business logistics in the CRM.

* Write and maintain SOPs for the booking-to-voucher process and group handling.

* Identify repetitive work and introduce AI and automation tools for quotations, follow-ups and reporting.

* Share weekly reports on enquiries, bookings, revenue, margins and pending payments with management.

* Suggest improvements to the tourism business model based on data and customer feedback.

* Plan campaigns and social media content with the marketing team or agency.

* Organize and host customer events, travel shows and destination presentations.

* Strengthen the Vithu Tours brand across every customer touchpoint.

* Design and run loyalty and referral programmes for customers, and reward schemes for the team.

* Build and maintain relationships with investors, management and internal teams (Sales, Finance, HR).

* Support the founder on new destinations, products and partnerships.

* Travel domestically or internationally with corporate and event groups when required. Separate incentives are paid for such travel.

* Be available outside office hours and on weekends while clients are travelling.

Skills and qualificationsRequired

* Graduate in any discipline. A degree or diploma in travel, tourism, hospitality or business management is preferred.

* 4–8 years in travel, tourism or hospitality, with hands-on operations experience.

* Working knowledge of visa processes for popular destinations such as Dubai, Schengen countries, Thailand, Vietnam and Singapore.

* Experience with flight booking portals or GDS (Amadeus, Galileo), hotel extranets and B2B travel portals.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and comfort using a CRM.

* Basic understanding of GST, TCS and travel-industry billing.

* Fluent English, Hindi and Marathi, written and spoken.

* Willingness to travel and to be available during client trips.

Preferred

* Experience handling corporate, MICE or large group tours.

* Familiarity with AI tools and automation (for example ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier or WhatsApp Business automation).

* Experience planning social media campaigns or hosting events.

* Existing network of hotels, DMCs and transport partners.

Personal qualities

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and handling several bookings and priorities at once.

* Strong attention to detail, since one wrong name or date is costly in travel.

* Calm, practical problem-solving under pressure and across time zones.

* Clear communicator who builds trust with customers, partners and investors.

* Self-starter who takes ownership and likes building systems.

What we offer

* Salary: ₹18,000–25,000 per month, based on experience

* Monthly incentives and bonuses on bookings and growth targets, paid over and above salary

* Separate incentives for travel with groups

* Opportunity to travel domestically and internationally

* A key role in a growing company, with room to shape its systems and brand

Send your CV and a short note on your operations experience to info@vithutours.com with the subject line **Application – Tourism Business Operations & Business Development Manager**.

Lifecycle Management

* Integrate SAM processes into broader IT Service Management (ITSM) workflows

title: Sales Officer Executive
description:
Job description:

SALES OFFICER

Field Sales & Operations

THE ROLE

Own your territory. Build the pipeline. Grow your earnings.

* As a Sales Officer, you own the business pipeline for your assigned territory.
* Find businesses, convert them for on-site video data collection, and keep the recording pipeline running.
* Spend your days in the field meeting business owners face to face, closing them, and expanding into nearby towns and industrial clusters.
* Your effort directly impacts your conversion volume and incentive payout.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Build the business pipeline — your core job

* Convert new businesses every day for commercial video data collection and build your daily conversion count.
* Target factories, manufacturing units, workshops, service centers, commercial kitchens, warehouses, printing & packaging units and facility management operations.
* Multi-worker and 2-shift environments are especially valuable.
* Complete the conversion form fully and accurately for every business on the same day.
* A converted business means a real, reachable business that is scheduled and ready for recording.

2. Scout and expand your territory

* Map and open up nearby towns and industrial clusters assigned to your territory.
* Spot new commercial categories and corridors with high recording potential.
* Build corridor-level knowledge of streets, estates and clusters with a high concentration of qualifying businesses.

3. Own recording day

* Support field operations on recording days at businesses you converted.
* Resolve owner concerns, access issues and scheduling conflicts on the spot.
* Keep the internal coordinator updated on pipeline status, scheduled recordings and on-ground issues.
* Maintain the relationship through the full recording cycle.

INCENTIVE STRUCTURE — CALCULATED DAILY

Below 5 conversions/day: No incentive.

5–7 conversions/day: ₹100 per lead (₹500–₹700/day).

8–10 conversions/day: ₹120 per lead (₹960–₹1,200/day).

11–14 conversions/day: ₹200 per lead (₹2,200–₹2,800/day).

15+ conversions/day: ₹250 per lead (₹3,750 onwards/day).

Incentive Payment: Calculated daily and paid monthly.

Maximum Incentive: Uncapped.

Eligibility: Only verified and eligible business leads qualify.

Additional Conversions: Every lead above 15 earns ₹250.

Below 5 conversions in a day, no incentive is payable for that day. Every additional conversion above 15 continues at ₹250 per lead — there is no ceiling on a big day.

HOW INCENTIVES ARE COUNTED

* Verified lead: A real, operating business at a physical address, with a named decision-maker whose mobile number is confirmed by call and physical visit, plus a geo-stamped photo of the premises taken in the app. All tasks must be verifiable.
* Every lead is verified: Accuracy matters. Any fabricated or fake detail voids the incentive for that week.
* Eligible categories only: Only businesses submitted on the form, from the categories listed in the goal sheet, count towards incentives.
* No duplicates: Leads are matched on phone number, bank details and location.
* Quality, not just volume: Every business submitted must allow recording at the location. Each denial carries a ₹2,000 deduction, so convert businesses that are genuinely ready.
* Chains & multi-outlet businesses: Each outlet counts separately only if it is a distinct physical location with its own decision-maker and contact number. Outlets sharing one number or address count once.
* Disputes: Raise a disagreement within 7 days; an independent reviewer will assess it.
* Calculation basis: Incentives are calculated on daily performance and paid monthly.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

LOCALITE: Native fluency in the local language of the zone, plus working English or Hindi (mandatory).

EXPERIENCE: Minimum 1 year as a Field Sales Executive, Business Development Executive or an equivalent field-facing role.

NETWORK: An existing network of business owners in the region — you should be able to name and reach real business owners in your territory. This comes up in the interview.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU ARE

* A field sales or vendor acquisition professional who closes face to face.
* Energised by being on the road across your territory every day.
* A high-ownership operator who treats your territory like your own business.
* Someone who wants earnings tied to output, with no ceiling on a good month.

WORK DETAILS

Role type: Full-time contract role — 6-month contract

Work mode: 100% field-based

Travel: Extensive daily travel across your territory, including nearby mapped towns

Reporting: Zone Lead + internal coordinator (daily updates)

Benefits:

* Health insurance

* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

* Pune, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

**Position: Field Sales Executive – Ice Cream Division**

**Location : Wakad, Pune ( Pimpri Chinchwad)**

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

The Field Sales Executive shall be responsible for expanding the company's ice cream retail network, identifying and onboarding new retail outlets, installing company-provided deep freezers at approved retail locations, generating ice cream sales, ensuring timely delivery of customer orders and maintaining strong relationships with retailers.

The employee shall act as the primary point of contact between the company and its retail outlets and shall ensure effective execution of sales, distribution and freezer management activities within the assigned territory.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. New Retailer Development & Freezer Installation**

* Approach potential retail outlets, grocery stores, supermarkets, ice cream parlours and other suitable locations.
* Generate new business by onboarding retailers and expanding the company's market presence.
* Coordinate and arrange installation of company-owned deep freezers at approved retail outlets.
* Complete necessary documentation, retailer agreements and freezer handover formalities.
* Maintain an updated record of all installed freezers, including retailer details, installation dates and freezer identification numbers.
* Conduct regular visits to ensure proper utilisation and safe custody of company freezers.

**B. Ice Cream Sales & Business Development**

* Promote and sell the company's ice cream products at assigned retail outlets.
* Ensure regular order generation from existing retailers.
* Achieve assigned daily, weekly and monthly sales targets.
* Introduce new products, flavours and promotional schemes to retailers.
* Ensure proper product visibility, display and stock availability at retail outlets.
* Develop strong business relationships with retailers and encourage repeat orders.
* Identify opportunities for increasing sales and expanding the retailer network.

**C. Order Collection & Timely Delivery**

* Collect orders from retail outlets through physical visits, telephone calls or other approved communication channels.
* Coordinate with the company's dispatch and distribution team for order processing.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of ice cream orders to respective retail outlets.
* Maintain proper product handling and cold-chain requirements during transportation.
* Verify quantities and product details at the time of delivery.
* Obtain retailer acknowledgement for delivered goods.
* Report delivery delays, shortages, damaged products or customer complaints immediately.
* Ensure proper coordination between sales, dispatch and retail customers.

**D. Retailer Relationship & Market Coverage**

* Conduct regular visits to all assigned retail outlets.
* Maintain good relations with existing retailers and resolve their routine concerns.
* Ensure timely communication of new schemes, offers and product launches.
* Collect market feedback and share it with the reporting manager.
* Identify inactive retailers and take necessary steps to reactivate them.
* Ensure adequate stock availability and prevent stock-outs at important outlets.

**E. Reporting & Documentation**

* Submit daily sales and collection reports.
* Maintain records of retailer-wise sales, orders, deliveries and outstanding payments.
* Maintain records of new retailer additions and freezer installations.
* Submit daily visit reports and market development updates.
* Report damaged, non-functional or idle freezers.
* Follow company policies, reporting procedures and instructions issued by management.

**3. Mandatory Eligibility & Requirements**

* **Language:** Ability to read and understand both Marathi and English is mandatory.
* **Driving:** Must know how to drive a two-wheeler.
* **Driving Licence:** Valid two-wheeler driving licence is mandatory.
* **Education:** Minimum 10th / 12th pass preferred.
* **Experience:** Experience in FMCG sales, ice cream distribution, retail sales or field marketing will be preferred. Freshers with good communication and sales skills may also apply.
* **Skills:** Good communication, retailer handling, sales negotiation and basic reporting skills.
* **Mobility:** Must be willing to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
* **Personal Attributes:** Honest, disciplined, target-oriented, punctual and customer-focused.
