title: Senior Specialist – US / UK Accounts Receivable & Collections
description:
**Job Description: Senior Specialist – US / UK Accounts Receivable & Collections**

  

* **Department:** Finance & Operations Governance
* **Experience Level:** 8–10 Years (B2B Global/US Collections Focus)
* **Reporting To:** Finance Head
* **Location:** Pune, India
* **Work Schedule:** US Business Hours (Aligning with US Client Time Zones)
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time

  

**1. Executive Summary & Purpose**

The **Senior Specialist – US Accounts Receivable & Collections** is directly responsible for safeguarding Indovance’s working capital by managing the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) loop for our US engineering and CAD/BIM services portfolio.

This is an strategic, outcome-oriented role focused on systematically reducing Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), driving past-due balance recoveries (30–120+ days), enforcing contract payment terms, and rapidly resolving billing or milestone disputes. Acting as the primary commercial bridge between US client Accounts Payable (AP) departments and internal Indovance stakeholders (Billing, Sales, Project Delivery), the candidate will implement clear, quantitative collection guardrails to optimize cash conversion and eliminate financial leakage.

  

**2. Key Operational & Strategic Responsibilities**

**A. US Customer Collections & Cash Conversion Management**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Independently drive collections for assigned US engineering, architectural, and structural client accounts.

  

* **Active Engagement:** Maintain direct, structured communication via phone calls and formal written correspondence with customer AP teams, Controllers, and Procurement Leads to lock in payment dates and remittance details.

  

* **Behavioral Tracking:** Monitor historical payment cycles and customer settlement behaviors to proactively flag accounts with impending overdue risks.

  

* **Systematic Cadence:** Establish clear, automated follow-up rhythms for pre-due invoice acknowledgments, payment approvals, and scheduled remittance verification.

  

**B. Aged Receivables Recovery & Risk Governance**

* **Ageing Analysis & Prioritization:** Continuously audit AR ageing schedules (30, 60, 90, and 120+ days) to prioritize intervention based on exposure value and collection probability.

  

* **Targeted Recovery Plans:** Design and execute account-specific recovery strategies for high-value delinquent balances and broken payment promises.

  

* **Bad Debt Mitigation:** Identify bad debt risks early; prepare structured escalation dossiers for executive leadership and enforce commercial pause/hold triggers on deliverable releases in accordance with corporate policy.

  

* **Audit & Reporting:** Maintain real-time collection notes and weekly AR risk registers detailing committed cash flows, pending collection hurdles, and probability-weighted recoveries.

  

**C. Dispute Resolution & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* **Root-Cause Analysis:** Investigate overdue balances resulting from missing Purchase Orders (POs), scope deviations, short payments, tax deductions, or incorrect invoice routing.

  

* **Internal Coordination:** Work closely with Indovance Delivery Leads, Project Managers, and Billing Specialists to validate timesheets, project milestone completions, and change orders.

  

* **Deduction & Credit Management:** Reconcile short payments, credit notes, and unapplied cash balances to ensure accurate customer ledger positions.

  

* **Process Feedback Loop:** Identify recurring billing errors or customer approval bottlenecks and provide actionable feedback to upstream billing and contracting teams.

  

**D. Billing System & Customer Portal Integration**

* **Portal Management:** Navigate customer AP platforms (e.g., Coupa, Ariba, Bill.com) to track invoice submission approvals, payment batches, and approval routing.

  

* **ERP Precision:** Ensure accurate, daily recordkeeping of remittance receipts, payment applications, and communication histories in enterprise accounting systems (e.g., Zoho Books, NetSuite).

  

* **Compliance & Governance:** Align all client outreach with US commercial payment practices and Indovance’s internal governance standards.

  

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Target Metrics**

**Performance Metric**

**Objective / Target Standard**

  

**Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)**

Achieve and maintain account portfolio DSO within targets.

  

**Overdue Reduction (>60/90 Days)**

Reduce >60-day past-due balance to < 5% of total portfolio exposure.

  

**Collection Efficiency Index (CEI)**

Achieve >90% cash collection target on total current receivables monthly.

  

**Dispute Resolution SLA**

Identify, assign, and resolve invoice discrepancies within 5 business days.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**The opportunity**

The product owner will be responsible for the technology analysis, end user research, future product planning, and cradle-to-grave life-cycle management of the product that is developed. You will build products from existing ideas, and help to develop new ideas based on your industry experience and your contact with customers and prospects. You must possess a unique blend of business and technical savvy; a big-picture vision, create a vision of the product from an end user perspective, and the drive to make that vision a reality. You must enjoy spending time in the market to understand their problems, and find innovative solutions for the broader market. You must be able to communicate with all areas of the company. You will work with a technology counterpart to define product release requirements. You will work closely with various stakeholders to make business decisions and create product strategies that ensure the long-term sustainability of the products or tools. You will also serve as the internal and external evangelist for your product offering, occasionally working with the sales channel and key customers.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Identifying, evaluating, and planning new software products using lean/agile principles.
* Creating use-cases and related requirements materials for use by our development/technology teams
* Defining minimum viable product features (MVP) and/or pivoting existing products.
* Propose product strategy changes because of competitive changes in the marketplace.
* Working cross-functionally, define and drive alignment and implementation of the software roadmap including products, services, and solutions.
* Closely collaborate with cross-functional teams across business, technical and implementation teams to define product requirements to build and own the product roadmap.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog together with product management.
* Report to Global leadership on product status, management of budget etc.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of customers’ challenges and needs to clearly define product requirements
* Manage the product life cycle
* Assist in the build / buy strategy including recommendations for current solutions
* Communicate and drive organizational alignment on software deployment with key stakeholders including end users
* Works with the technology and client services teams to build and enhance products from existing ideas, and help develop new concepts based on industry research and the needs of end user

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Experience with HR / Payroll technology solutions and a good understanding of global HRIS / HR / Payroll technology landscape
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done
* Ability to effectively work as a leader in a cross functional team environment including business and product development, supply chain and procurement processes and execution dependencies
* Strong track record of influencing successful product/solution vision/roadmap and executing to a plan
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and expertise in communicating with teams across geographies
* Excellent knowledge of Design Thinking and User Experience methodologies.
* Strategic thinker who is comfortable in a fast-paced, always-on, ambiguous start-up environment

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in engineering (Computer Science/ Technology
* 12 - 15 years of experience in IT/software industry with at least 6 years in capacity of product manager.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Knowledge and experience in dealing with cross platform mobile applications.
* Demonstrated success in delivering high quality technology products/services in a very high growth environment where priorities shift rapidly.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. title: SALES OFFICER Field Sales & Operations
description:
SALES OFFICER

Field Sales & Operations

THE ROLE

Own your territory. Build the pipeline. Grow your earnings.

* As a Sales Officer, you own the business pipeline for your assigned territory.

* Find businesses, convert them for on-site video data collection, and keep the recording pipeline running.

* Spend your days in the field meeting business owners face to face, closing them, and expanding into nearby towns and industrial clusters.

* Your effort directly impacts your conversion volume and incentive payout.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Build the business pipeline — your core job

* Convert new businesses every day for commercial video data collection and build your daily conversion count.

* Target factories, manufacturing units, workshops, service centers, commercial kitchens, warehouses, printing & packaging units and facility management operations.

* Multi-worker and 2-shift environments are especially valuable.

* Complete the conversion form fully and accurately for every business on the same day.

* A converted business means a real, reachable business that is scheduled and ready for recording.

2. Scout and expand your territory

* Map and open up nearby towns and industrial clusters assigned to your territory.

* Spot new commercial categories and corridors with high recording potential.

* Build corridor-level knowledge of streets, estates and clusters with a high concentration of qualifying businesses.

3. Own recording day

* Support field operations on recording days at businesses you converted.

* Resolve owner concerns, access issues and scheduling conflicts on the spot.

* Keep the internal coordinator updated on pipeline status, scheduled recordings and on-ground issues.

* Maintain the relationship through the full recording cycle.

INCENTIVE STRUCTURE — CALCULATED DAILY

Below 5 conversions/day: No incentive.

5–7 conversions/day: ₹100 per lead (₹500–₹700/day).

8–10 conversions/day: ₹120 per lead (₹960–₹1,200/day).

11–14 conversions/day: ₹200 per lead (₹2,200–₹2,800/day).

15+ conversions/day: ₹250 per lead (₹3,750 onwards/day).

Incentive Payment: Calculated daily and paid monthly.

Maximum Incentive: Uncapped.

Eligibility: Only verified and eligible business leads qualify.

Additional Conversions: Every lead above 15 earns ₹250.

Below 5 conversions in a day, no incentive is payable for that day. Every additional conversion above 15 continues at ₹250 per lead — there is no ceiling on a big day.

HOW INCENTIVES ARE COUNTED

* Verified lead: A real, operating business at a physical address, with a named decision-maker whose mobile number is confirmed by call and physical visit, plus a geo-stamped photo of the premises taken in the app. All tasks must be verifiable.

* Every lead is verified: Accuracy matters. Any fabricated or fake detail voids the incentive for that week.

* Eligible categories only: Only businesses submitted on the form, from the categories listed in the goal sheet, count towards incentives.

* No duplicates: Leads are matched on phone number, bank details and location.

* Quality, not just volume: Every business submitted must allow recording at the location. Each denial carries a ₹2,000 deduction, so convert businesses that are genuinely ready.

* Chains & multi-outlet businesses: Each outlet counts separately only if it is a distinct physical location with its own decision-maker and contact number. Outlets sharing one number or address count once.

* Disputes: Raise a disagreement within 7 days; an independent reviewer will assess it.

* Calculation basis: Incentives are calculated on daily performance and paid monthly.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

LOCALITE: Native fluency in the local language of the zone, plus working English or Hindi (mandatory).

EXPERIENCE: Minimum 1 year as a Field Sales Executive, Business Development Executive or an equivalent field-facing role.

NETWORK: An existing network of business owners in the region — you should be able to name and reach real business owners in your territory. This comes up in the interview.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU ARE

* A field sales or vendor acquisition professional who closes face to face.

* Energised by being on the road across your territory every day.

* A high-ownership operator who treats your territory like your own business.

* Someone who wants earnings tied to output, with no ceiling on a good month.

WORK DETAILS

Role type: Full-time contract role — 6-month contract

Work mode: 100% field-based

Travel: Extensive daily travel across your territory, including nearby mapped towns

Reporting: Zone Lead + internal coordinator (daily updates)

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Pune, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Location:

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

**Software Engineering Manager, AI Migrations (Forward Deployed)**
------------------------------------------------------------------

**Location:** Pune, India

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.

Snowflake redefined the data landscape over a decade ago, and our biggest opportunity is also our customers' biggest challenge: **migration**. For every enterprise ready to harness the AI Data Cloud, there is a complex web of legacy systems that can take years and millions of dollars to untangle. We believe generative AI is the key. We are building products that don't just move data, but understand and rewrite the logic of entire data applications.

We are hiring a **Software Engineering Manager, AI Migrations (Forward Deployed)** to work at the intersection of customer delivery and product engineering. In this hybrid role, you will lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers who work directly with customers and partners on complex migrations, while also driving the development of AI-powered migration tools and products. Your team will be the bridge between field realities and product innovation, turning hard-won migration patterns into scalable, automated solutions.

### **AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER, AI MIGRATIONS AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:**

**Lead and develop the team**

* Manage and mentor a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, giving clear feedback and building growth paths
* Recruit, hire and onboard engineers who can succeed in both customer delivery and engineering
* Grow technical delivery leads and engineering leaders, including staff-level engineers
* Foster a culture of creativity, innovation and practical decision-making

**Deliver customer migrations**

* Lead complex migrations from legacy platforms such as Oracle, Teradata, Netezza and SQL Server to Snowflake
* Provide strategic oversight so projects align with customer objectives and Snowflake's goals
* Act as the primary escalation point for delivery, working closely with customers and system integrators
* Stay hands-on in strategic projects to assess quality and unblock teams
* Partner with sales teams to scope opportunities, estimate effort, develop proposals and support account strategy

**Build AI-powered migration products**

* Drive the design, development and iteration of AI-powered migration tools based on real customer needs
* Guide the team in building AI-first products, including code translation, developer co-pilots and semantic validation
* Turn field insights into engineering roadmap items and product improvements
* Partner with Engineering and Product Management to align priorities and deliver high-quality solutions
* Develop and share best practices, utilities and accelerators that speed up migrations and feed back into the product

**Drive cross-functional impact**

* Influence go-to-market strategy and lead improvements across Sales and Engineering
* Encourage knowledge sharing between field engineers and product engineering teams
* Present migration strategy, product vision and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences

### **OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE:**

* A university degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of experience in technical roles spanning customer-facing delivery and engineering
* 5+ years of people management experience, mentoring and developing technical teams
* 3+ years of experience building and delivering enterprise software products, ideally involving AI/ML or developer tools
* A proven track record of leading teams through complex data platform migrations and cloud transformations
* A strong foundation in databases, data warehousing and data processing, with hands-on experience on large-scale systems such as Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, SQL Server, Greenplum or Hadoop
* A deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and the full data analytics stack, including ETL, data platform design and BI
* Extensive hands-on expertise in SQL and scripting (Python, Perl or Bash)
* Experience scoping engagements, including delivery estimates, proposals and project plans
* The flexibility to step into product manager, program manager or architect roles when needed
* Excellent presentation skills for technical and executive audiences

### **BONUS POINTS FOR:**

* Experience with data integration and transformation tools such as Informatica, DataStage, Talend, Matillion or dbt
* Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, MicroStrategy or Business Objects
* Experience building GenAI-powered developer tools, such as code translation or co-pilots

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

description:
Job Description

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Security risk assessment and solution design**

* **Conduct site surveys and security risk / vulnerability assessments; define security zones,**

**threat scenarios and layered (deter–detect–delay–respond) protection concepts.**

* **Design integrated solutions: IP CCTV, video management systems (VMS), AI video**

**analytics, access control, turnstiles and entrance automation, perimeter intrusion**

**detection, vehicle access control and command & control centres.**

* **Produce design deliverables: camera placement and field-of-view plans (DORI),**

**access control schematics, door hardware schedules, network and storage architecture,**

**single-line diagrams, rack layouts and cable schedules.**

* **Size infrastructure correctly: bandwidth, storage and retention, server/compute**

**(including GPU for analytics), redundancy and failover, UPS/power and PoE budgets.**

* **Design for compliance and cybersecurity: ONVIF interoperability, IEC 62676, IEC**

**62443 practice, secure device hardening, and Indian regulations such as MeitY/STQC**

**CCTV certification requirements, along with sector norms (e.g. BCAS for airports, ISPS**

**Code for ports).**

* **Coordinate with civil, electrical, fire & safety and IT teams on poles, trenching, ducts,**

**door hardware, power and network readiness.**

**2. Pre-sales, bids and commercials**

* **Own technical responses to RFPs, RFQs and tenders (including GeM, CPPP, PSU, port**

**and airport authority tenders): compliance matrices, deviations, technical write-ups and**

**presentations.**

* **Prepare accurate BOQs and costings with the commercial team; offer value-engineered**

**options without compromising security outcomes.**

* **Ensure tender compliance, including Make in India / PPP-MII, restrictions on country-oforigin**

**where applicable, OEM authorisation (MAF), warranty and AMC terms.**

* **Run product demonstrations, analytics proofs of concept and pilots; present solutions to**

**CSOs, plant heads, CISOs and administration leaders.**

* **Support sales in account planning, opportunity qualification and win strategy for large**

**and multi-site deals.**

**3. OEM and partner management**

* **Act as Syntel's technical point of contact with security OEMs and national distributors in**

**India; secure deal registrations, pricing and OEM design support.**

* **Maintain partner tiers and certification targets; track product roadmaps, cybersecurity**

**advisories and end-of-life notices.**

* **Evaluate new technologies (AI analytics, cloud VMS, mobile credentials, radar and**

**thermal detection) and recommend portfolio additions, including opportunities to**

**integrate Syntel's own AI video analytics.**

**4. Implementation and project leadership**

* **Lead design-to-delivery handover: approved drawings, configuration standards, IP plans,**

**test procedures and acceptance criteria.**

* **Provide technical leadership to project managers, engineers and subcontractors during**

**installation, configuration, integration and commissioning.**

* **Lead integration across subsystems: VMS with access control, fire alarm, PA, ANPR,**

**intrusion and PSIM; integration with HRMS, SAP/ERP and visitor management systems.**

* **Run factory/site acceptance tests and sign off on system performance, including**

**analytics accuracy, before customer handover.**

* **Resolve escalated technical issues and change requests; manage design risks against**

**scope, schedule and budget.**

* **Define as-built documentation, SOPs for control room operators, user training and**

**AMC/support handover.**

**5. Practice building**

* **Build reference architectures, standard design templates, BOQ libraries and proposal**

**content for key verticals (manufacturing, ports, airports, enterprise campuses).**

* **Mentor pre-sales and project engineers; drive OEM certification plans for the team.**

* **Work with Syntel's networking, unified communication and R&D teams on integrated,**

**differentiated offerings.**

**Technical Skills and OEM Expertise**

**Hands-on experience is expected across most of the following areas. Depth in at least three**

**major OEM ecosystems (camera, VMS and access control) is essential.**

**Area Platforms, products and know-how**

**IP cameras & CCTV • Axis, Bosch, Hanwha Vision, Honeywell, i-PRO, Avigilon/Pelco, CP**

**Plus, Prama, Matrix**

* **Fixed, PTZ, multi-sensor, fisheye, thermal and explosion-proof**

**cameras; lens and lighting selection, WDR/low-light, DORI design**

**Axis Camera Station**

* **Recording architecture, failover, federation, multi-site design, video**

**wall and control room integration**

**AI video analytics • Intrusion, loitering, crowd, PPE compliance, fire/smoke, ANPR/LPR,**

**face recognition, object left/removed, people counting, forensic**

**search**

* **Videonetics, BriefCam and OEM edge/server analytics; GPU sizing,**

**accuracy testing and false-alarm tuning**

**Access control &**

**identity**

**• HID, Honeywell / LenelS2, Johnson Controls (C•CURE), Genetec**

**Synergis, Matrix COSEC, Suprema, IDEMIA**

* **Card, biometric and mobile credentials; controllers, door hardware,**

**EM locks, interlocks, anti-passback, visitor management, time &**

**attendance integration**

**Entrance automation • Tripod, flap, swing and full-height turnstiles, speed gates, security**

**doors and mantraps (Gunnebo, dormakaba, Boon Edam, Magnetic**

**Autocontrol, Automatic Systems)**

* **Boom barriers, bollards, road blockers, tyre killers, UVSS (undervehicle**

**scanning)**

**Perimeter & screening • Fence-mounted and fibre-optic PIDS, buried cable, microwave and**

**IR barriers, radar, thermal detection (Senstar, Southwest Microwave,**

**Teledyne FLIR, Navtech)**

* **X-ray baggage scanners, DFMD/HHMD (Smiths Detection,**

**Rapiscan, CEIA, Garrett)**

**Command & control /**

**PSIM**

**platforms (Genetec, Hexagon, Everbridge) and ICCC-style**

**integration**

* **Integration with fire alarm, PA, intercom, BMS and emergency**

**response workflows**

* **Industrial and enterprise switching, VLANs, multicast, PoE, ring/fibre**

**topologies, wireless backhaul**

**hardening, certificates, NDAA/country-of-origin awareness**

**Design tools • AutoCAD, Microsoft Visio, IP Video System Design Tool (JVSG),**

title: Business Enhancement and Growth Executive
description:
Job Title: Business Enhancement and Growth Executive  
Company: Trivium Media Group  
Location: Koregaon Park, Pune, Maharashtra, India  
Workplace Type: On-site  
Employment Type: Full-time  
Industry: Advertising Services; Public Relations and Communications Services; Media Production  
Job Function: Business Development, Marketing

**About Trivium Media Group:-**  
Trivium Media Group (TMG) is an integrated media, communications and brand growth agency offering 360-degree solutions across Advertising, Public Relations, Branding, Digital Marketing, Creative Communications and Media Production. With over 15 years of industry experience and a presence across India, the UK, UAE and Qatar, TMG partners with businesses, brands and institutions to strengthen their market presence, build brand equity and drive sustainable growth.

Through a combination of strategic thinking, creative capabilities, industry relationships and integrated communication solutions, TMG works across diverse sectors to develop impactful brand experiences and meaningful business outcomes.

**About the Role:-**  
We are looking for a dynamic and commercially driven Business Enhancement and Growth Executive to drive new business opportunities, develop strategic partnerships and contribute to the organisation's overall business expansion.

The role involves identifying prospective clients and business networks, building strong corporate relationships, exploring collaboration opportunities and converting potential leads into long-term business associations. The individual will work closely with the leadership team and internal departments to identify growth opportunities, understand market requirements and develop business strategies that contribute to TMG's revenue and market expansion objectives.

**What You'll Do – Key Responsibilities:-**

* Business Development & Lead Generation: Identify, research and develop new business opportunities across corporates, brands, real estate developers, hospitality groups, institutions, agencies and other relevant industries.
* Strategic Partnerships & Alliances: Identify and establish strategic partnerships, corporate alliances, channel partnerships and business associations to create new revenue opportunities for TMG.
* Client Acquisition: Proactively approach prospective clients, initiate business conversations, understand their requirements and convert qualified opportunities into business engagements.
* Corporate Relationship Management: Build, develop and maintain relationships with business owners, CXOs, marketing heads, brand managers, corporate representatives and other key decision-makers.
* Market Research & Opportunity Mapping: Conduct market research to identify potential industries, target companies, emerging business segments, market trends and opportunities for business expansion.
* Business Presentations & Proposals: Develop and coordinate business proposals, presentations, credentials, pitch decks and commercial submissions in collaboration with the relevant internal teams.
* Client Meetings & Business Negotiations: Represent TMG in client meetings, corporate presentations, networking forums and industry events, while actively participating in commercial discussions and negotiations.
* Revenue Generation & Conversion: Drive business opportunities from initial outreach and lead qualification through proposal submission, negotiation, closure and onboarding.
* Existing Client Growth: Identify opportunities for account expansion, cross-selling and upselling TMG's services across existing client relationships.
* Networking & Industry Representation: Actively participate in industry associations, business forums, conferences, exhibitions and networking events to strengthen TMG's corporate presence and develop new business connections.
* Internal Coordination: Work closely with PR, Digital Marketing, Branding, Creative, Media Production and other internal teams to understand service capabilities and develop relevant business solutions for prospective clients.
* Pipeline & Performance Management: Maintain an updated business development pipeline, track leads, meetings, proposals, conversions and follow-ups, and share periodic business development reports with management.
* Business Expansion Initiatives: Work alongside the leadership team to explore new markets, industry segments, service opportunities and strategic initiatives that contribute to TMG's long-term growth.

**What You’ll Bring:-**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong networking and relationship-management abilities
* Good negotiation, presentation, and persuasion skills
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness
* Ability to identify and evaluate business opportunities
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and organizational skills
* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
* Proactive, self-motivated, and target-oriented approach
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams

**Qualifications:-**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Business Development, or a related field is an added advantage
* 1–3 years of experience in Business Development, Client Relations, Sales, Strategic Partnerships, Corporate Relations, Public Relations, or a similar role.

**Why Join Trivium Media Group?**

* Work with diverse brands and businesses
* Exposure to Advertising, Public Relations, Digital Marketing, Branding, and Media
* Contribute to business expansion and new initiatives
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment
* Opportunities for professional growth and learning
* Performance-based incentives and career development

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹480,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Job Description:

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

SAP SD – End User Ownership

* Act as a power user and functional expert for SAP SD covering key Order-to-Cash processes, including order creation, order changes, pricing, delivery coordination, billing triggers, and status tracking.
* Execute and validate SD transactions such as sales orders, order blocks, delivery blocks, billing blocks, returns, cancellations, and free-of-charge orders.
* Ensure pricing accuracy, condition records, rebates, and contract compliance within SAP SD.
* Perform root-cause analysis for SD-related errors and inconsistencies and work with IT for permanent fixes.

EDI Operations & Exception Management

* Monitor, analyse, and manage EDI transactions (e.g. orders, acknowledgements, invoices, ASNs) to ensure successful end-to-end processing.
* Identify and resolve EDI failures related to master data, pricing, quantities, scheduling, or partner setup.
* Act as the first-level functional owner for EDI exception queues, coordinating with customers, 3PLs, and IT teams.

Data Quality & Governance

* Own master data and transactional data accuracy impacting SD and EDI processes (customer master, material master, pricing, routes, partner functions, etc.).
* Support data governance initiatives by ensuring adherence to SOPs, controls, and audit requirements.
* Identify recurring data issues and partner with data governance or IT teams for long-term resolution.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Knowledge Enablement

* Act as a bridge between business users and IT, providing functional clarity on SD and EDI processes.
* Collaborate closely with Global / North America Supply Chain stakeholders on issue resolution and process alignment.
* Create and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and training material for SAP SD and EDI processes.
* Guide and support junior team members, helping build functional depth within the team.
  

**Experience Requirements:**

**Must-Haves:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or related field.

* 3-5 years of experience in order management or supply chain operations with global exposure.

3. Strong working knowledge of Order-to-Cash processes and their integration with logistics and billing.

4. Practical experience in EDI monitoring, exception handling, and partner coordination.

5. Strong understanding of supply chain execution concepts (order fulfilment, logistics, inventory, service levels).

6. High attention to detail with a strong data and control mindset.

description:
Job Description

**Position-** **Salesforce Consultant (Freelancer)**  
**Experience- 5+ Years**  
**Location- Remote**  
**Contract Duration- 4 Months**  
  
  
**A Salesforce Engineer to deliver a client project for a US-based enterprise. The client is replacing a third-party presales tool (Vivun) with native Salesforce functionality. The solution relies on standard configuration and Flow, using Apex only where configuration cannot meet the requirement. The candidate will work with the client’s business leads and their internal Salesforce team, who will own the solution after go-live.**

  
  

**The project has three phases:**

  
  

* **Activity Tracking (priority, due by year-end). About 21 solution consultants log time against an opportunity, an account, or no record for internal work. Includes calendar capture and reporting.**

* **Opportunity Automation. When an opportunity is closed and replaced, the related data is carried over to the new one so metrics are not lost.**

* **Collaboration Requests. About 60+ sales reps request solution consultant support. Includes request routing and opportunity team updates.**

  
  

**Key responsibilities**

* Join requirement workshops and turn business questions into documented solution designs.

* Review the existing org, including Vivun package dependencies, the legacy activity setup, and automation that may conflict with new Flows.

* Assess Einstein Activity Capture with Outlook: licensing, custom-field support, how activities are stored, and reporting fit.

* Configure custom fields, objects, record types, dependent picklists, validation rules, page layouts and Dynamic Forms.

* Build Flows (screen, record-triggered and scheduled), including:

* a quick action to clone a replacement opportunity with its team members and related records

* Opportunity Team Member automation

* error handling and an audit trail

* automated reminders for missing time entries

* Configure queues, assignment logic and email/in-app notifications for collaboration requests.

* Write Apex with test classes where Flow is not enough.

* Build reports and dashboards for SC activity, demo counts, win/loss and time spent.

* Update profiles and permission sets as needed for new functionality.

* Support UAT, fix defects, and deploy through the client’s release process.

* Produce technical design documentation and hand over to the client’s Salesforce team.

  
  

**Required qualifications**

* Hands-on Salesforce experience, mainly in Sales Cloud.

* Strong knowledge of Opportunities, Opportunity Teams, Accounts, Contacts, and Tasks/Events.

* Advanced Flow skills: screen, record-triggered and scheduled flows, subflows, fault paths, bulk-safe design.

* Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL, triggers and test classes.

* Experience with record cloning that includes related records.

* Experience with reports, dashboards and custom report types.

* Experience with queues, assignment logic and notifications.

* Deployment experience using change sets, Salesforce CLI or DevOps Center.

* Comfortable working directly with US-based business stakeholders.

* Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator.

We are expanding our automotive refinish business in Maharashtra and are looking for a result-oriented Retail Sales Manager to develop and grow our retail and aftermarket business across Pune and surrounding markets.

The Retail Sales Manager will be responsible for developing automotive refinish paint sales across the assigned territory through dealers, distributors, retailers, bodyshops, garages and automotive painters.

The candidate will drive sales growth, expand the dealer network, acquire new customers, conduct product trials, develop painter relationships and increase market penetration.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in automotive refinish paint sales, a strong understanding of the automotive aftermarket and an established network of dealers, garages and bodyshops in Pune and nearby markets.

1. Sales & Business Development

· Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets for the assigned territory.

· Identify new business opportunities and convert prospects into active customers.

· Generate sales through dealers, retailers, distributors, garages and bodyshops.

· Conduct regular market visits and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

· Develop new markets and increase penetration of Carecil automotive refinish products.

2. Dealer & Retail Network Development

· Identify, appoint and develop automotive paint dealers and retailers across Pune and nearby markets.

· Build strong relationships with existing channel partners.

· Expand the distribution network in uncovered and high-potential areas.

· Monitor dealer inventory, product movement and secondary sales.

· Ensure product availability and encourage repeat orders.

· Introduce new products, promotional schemes and channel development initiatives.

· Help dealers increase sales by developing business with local garages and bodyshops.

· Generate product trials and convert customers from competing brands.

· Visit workshops to understand product requirements and application challenges.

· Coordinate product demonstrations and technical support with the company's technical team.

· Develop key bodyshops into regular users of Carecil automotive refinish products.

· Build long-term relationships with workshop owners and decision-makers.

Greetings from Marvel Realtors and Developers Limited !!

I hope you are doing well.

I have opening for the below Job Description. Kindly go through the job details and attach me your **updated CV** to proceed for interview shortlisting.

Role overview

**CRM Executive**

Own the customer relationship from booking to possession and beyond — collecting every demand on schedule while making the buyer's journey clear, predictable and premium.

Location : Koregaon Park, Pune

6 days WFO (2nd and 4th Sat Off’s)

Company

Marvel Realtors, Pune

Title

CRM Manager – Collections & Customer Experience

Reports to

Director

Location

Pune (site + corporate office)

Experience

3– 4 years in real estate CRM, at least 3 in collections

Works with

Sales, Accounts, Legal, Project/Site, Banks & HFCs

Key responsibilities1. Booking to agreement

* Welcome call and welcome kit within 48 hours of booking; assign a single point of contact.
* Collect KYC, application form and booking amount; verify against sales terms.
* Coordinate Agreement for Sale drafting, stamp duty, registration appointment and handover of registered copy.
* Ensure cost sheet, payment plan and all commitments are documented — no verbal promises left unrecorded.

2. Collections

* Raise construction-linked demand letters the day a slab/stage is certified; share architect's certificate and site photos.
* Reminder cadence: advance notice, due-date reminder, then structured follow-up calls and letters.
* Coordinate loan disbursements with banks/HFCs — sanction, tripartite agreement, NOC, disbursement requests.
* Compute and communicate interest on delayed payments as per agreement; handle waiver requests with approval.
* Reconcile receipts with Accounts weekly; issue receipts and TDS (Form 16B) follow-ups.
* Escalate chronic defaulters with a documented trail; support cancellation or legal action when required.

3. Customer journey during construction

* Quarterly construction progress updates (photos, video, milestone status).
* Manage modification/customisation requests with cost and timeline sign-off.
* Resolve queries within defined turnaround; maintain a complete interaction log in the CRM system.
* Organise site visits and customer engagement events.

4. Possession

* Plan possession in batches: final demand, outstanding clearance, documentation checklist.
* Pre-possession unit inspection with customer; track snag list to closure before handover.
* Handover kit: keys, possession letter, OC copy, warranties, appliance manuals, maintenance guide.
* Coordinate electricity/water meter transfer, society/maintenance deposits and registration of society.

5. Post-possession

* Defect liability period: log, assign and close complaints within SLA under RERA obligations.
* Support society formation and conveyance to the society.
* Handle resale/rental NOCs and transfer requests.
* Drive referrals and testimonials; run satisfaction surveys at possession and 6 months after.

6. Compliance and reporting

* Keep customer records aligned with MahaRERA disclosures and quarterly updates.
* Weekly MIS: collections due vs received, ageing, escalations, open complaints.
* Handle MahaRERA / consumer complaints in coordination with Legal.

KPIs

Targets are indicative; finalise at offer stage.

KPI

Target

Collection efficiency (received ÷ demanded, monthly)

≥ 95%

Dues ageing beyond 60 days

< 3% of receivables

Demand letters issued after stage completion

Within 2 working days

Query first response / resolution

24 hours / 7 days

Snags closed before handover

100%

Post-possession complaint closure within SLA

≥ 90%

Customer satisfaction (possession survey)

≥ 4.5 / 5

Referral bookings from existing customers

Tracked quarterly

Escalations to MahaRERA / consumer forum

Zero

Qualifications and attributes

**Must have**

* Graduate (MBA preferred); 5–10 years in real estate CRM with hands-on collections.
* Working knowledge of Agreement for Sale, stamp duty and registration, home-loan disbursement process, MahaRERA and GST/TDS on property.
* Proficient in a CRM system (Salesforce, Sell.Do, Farvision or similar) and Excel/MIS.
* Fluent English, Marathi and Hindi — written and spoken.

**Attributes**

* Firm on money, warm with people: can chase dues without damaging the relationship.
* Ownership mindset — follows through to closure without reminders.
* Calm under pressure with escalated or upset customers.
* Polished presentation suited to premium/luxury clientele.
* Meticulous with documentation and audit trail.

**Good to have**

* Experience handling possession of a full project or tower.
* Exposure to luxury residential projects in Pune.

Thanks & Regards,

Yamini N,

Sr. Human Resource Generalist

Marvel Realtors and Development Limited,

title: Assistant Manager - Inventory
description:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Stock Accuracy and Control**

* Conduct daily cycle counts and monthly/quarterly full stock counts at the warehouse.
* Identify and resolve system vs. physical stock discrepancies; post approved ERP adjustments with appropriate reason codes.
* Track damaged inventory, plant mortality, and expiry; ensure timely movement of stock to bad inventory.
* Ensure accurate and timely GRC (Goods Receipt Confirmation) and verify short/excess receipts against purchase orders (POs).
* **Stock Planning and Cover Days**

* Track DRR (Daily Run Rate) and cover days by SKU on a daily basis.
* Categorise and flag SKUs by priority:
  + P1: 15 days or less
  + P2: 30 days or less
  + P3: 46 days or less
  + Excess stock: Above 46 days
* Plan stock transfers from Talegaon to branch warehouses based on demand and stock availability.
* Evaluate inter-warehouse transfer options before raising new purchase requirements.
* Share stock requirements with the Purchase team and Pune Production team for in-house products.
* **Bundles, BOM and Corporate Orders**

* Maintain the bundle master (BOM) and convert bundle sales into component-level stock requirements.
* Plan inventory for corporate gifting and seasonal/festival orders, including Diwali hampers and add-on products.
* **Slow-Moving and Dead Stock**

* Conduct monthly ABC and FMS (Fast-Moving, Medium-Moving, Slow-Moving) analysis.
* Plan liquidation, stock recalls from stores, and inventory rebalancing across branch warehouses and retail stores.
* **Reports, SOPs and Team Management**

* Prepare daily and monthly MIS reports covering stock summaries, cover days, ageing, stock value, and shrinkage.
* Develop and implement inventory SOPs for receiving, put-away, stock counting, transfers, and returns.
* Guide and train inventory executives at Talegaon and monitor their daily work.

**Sales and Account Executive – Fabrication & Powder Coating**

**Location:** Embross Systems Pvt. Ltd, Pune, India  
**Department:** Sales / Business Development  
**Reports To:** Plant Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Who are We**

At Embross, we build technology that quietly powers millions of travels experience every day. From check-in to boarding, there’s a strong chance that our hardware or software played a role in getting passengers where they need to go.

We partner with some of the world’s leading airlines and airports to deliver passenger automation and self-service solutions that make travel faster, simpler, and less stressful. For our partners, that means more efficient operations and better passenger experience. For us, it means solving complex, real-world challenges on a global scale.

What makes Embross unique is the breadth of what we do. We work across a diverse stack that blends hardware, software, and real-time systems in some of the busiest and most demanding environments in the world. It’s a space where creativity, engineering, and operational thinking come together.

If you’re motivated by meaningful problems, tangible impact, and the opportunity to shape how people move through the world, we should talk.

**What You'll Do**

We are looking for a motivated and results-oriented **Sales and Account Executive** to develop and grow our external customer business for our manufacturing facility in India.

Our plant currently supports the fabrication and powder coating requirements for our own passenger automation and self-service solutions. As part of our growth strategy, we are expanding these capabilities to serve external customers across various industries.

The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying potential customers, developing new business opportunities, visiting prospective clients, understanding their fabrication and finishing requirements, coordinating internally on quotations and feasibility, and converting opportunities into long-term customer relationships.

This is a hands-on B2B sales role that requires significant customer interaction, local market development, and regular travel to meet prospective and existing customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Development & Sales**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities for:
  + Sheet-metal fabrication
  + Metal cabinets and enclosures
  + Custom fabricated components
  + Powder coating and finishing services
  + Self service solutions on the domestic market, as a second phase.
  + Other related manufacturing capabilities offered by the plant

  

* Research and identify potential customers across relevant industries and geographic markets.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers.
* Conduct regular cold calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, networking, and in-person visits to generate new opportunities.
* Schedule and conduct meetings with prospective customers to understand their requirements.
* Visit customer facilities to understand their manufacturing, fabrication, finishing, quality, and delivery requirements.
* Prepare and deliver company and capability presentations to prospective customers.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and move opportunities through the sales cycle from initial contact to order placement.
* Develop relationships with purchasing managers, engineering teams, operations managers, plant managers, and business owners.

**Customer & Account Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers.
* Develop strong, long-term relationships with customers and identify opportunities for repeat and additional business.
* Understand customer requirements, specifications, volumes, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and properly communicated.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively address issues or concerns.
* Identify opportunities to increase business with existing customers.

**Quotation & Order Coordination**

* Work closely with the Plant, Engineering, Production, and Finance teams to develop competitive quotations.
* Gather necessary technical and commercial information from customers for quotation purposes.
* Coordinate customer drawings, specifications, quantities, materials, finishing requirements, and delivery expectations.
* Follow up on quotations and negotiate pricing and commercial terms within approved guidelines.
* Support the transition of new customers/orders from sales into production.
* Track orders and communicate status updates to customers as required.

**Market Development**

* Identify industries and customer segments that could benefit from our fabrication and powder-coating capabilities.
* Develop a target customer list and territory strategy.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and customer requirements.
* Attend relevant trade shows, industry events, networking events, and customer meetings to generate business.
* Continuously identify new applications and markets for the company's manufacturing capabilities.

**Reporting & Sales Planning**

* Maintain accurate records of prospects, opportunities, quotations, orders, and customer interactions.
* Provide regular sales pipeline and business development reports to management.
* Establish and work toward monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Track conversion rates, sales activity, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.
* Provide management with market feedback and recommendations regarding pricing, capabilities, and potential new services.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Success in this position will be measured by:

* Number of qualified new prospects developed.
* Number of customer visits and meetings.
* Number and value of quotations generated.
* New customers acquired.
* Revenue generated from external customers.
* Gross margin generated from new business.
* Conversion of prospects into customers.
* Repeat business and customer retention.
* Growth of the external fabrication and powder-coating business.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business, Sales, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related field preferred.
* 5+ years of B2B sales/business development experience, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Experience selling one or more of the following would be highly desirable:
  + Sheet-metal fabrication
  + Metal enclosures/cabinets
  + CNC/laser cutting, bending, welding or related fabrication
  + Powder coating
  + Industrial components
  + Contract manufacturing
  + OEM manufacturing
* Proven track record of developing new customers and generating business.

* Strong negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

title: Purchase Executive
description:
**ABOUT ADVISTA TECHNOSOLUTIONS**

Advista Technosolutions Pvt. Ltd. is a **Pune-based engineering services company** specialising in Industrial Instrumentation, Process Automation, and Turnkey Engineering Projects. Founded by an engineer with 20+ years of domain expertise, we serve **100+ clients across India and internationally** (UAE, Sri Lanka, Trinidad & Tobago, Vietnam). We are MSME Udyam Registered, DPIIT Recognised Startup, and SC-ST Hub Honoured by the Ministry of MSME.

We are a small, growing team at an exciting inflection point. The person joining in this role will work directly with the founder in a hands-on environment where **initiative, accuracy, and ownership** are valued above all else.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

This is a **dual-function role** combining **Accounts & Invoicing** with **Purchase & Vendor Management.** The Executive will handle the complete order-to-invoice cycle on the accounts side, and the enquiry-to-dispatch cycle on the purchase side. Both functions operate simultaneously — this role is suited for a candidate who is **organised, fast-paced, and comfortable with numbers, vendor communication, and documentation.**

*This is not a split role. Both functions are active daily. The ideal candidate treats both with equal ownership.*

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**PURCHASE & VENDOR MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Purchase Lead Register** on the same day of receipt without exception
* Check the internal rate/vendor database before floating any enquiry externally — mandatory first step for every new enquiry
* Float purchase enquiries to a minimum of 2 relevant vendors within 4 working hours if rates are unavailable in the database; ensure complete technical inputs are shared with vendors
* **24–48 hours** of receiving the enquiry — this is a non-negotiable TAT
* **Weboo workflow** on the same day; keep Biziverse CRM in sync with order status
* **Purchase Orders (POs)** on the confirmed vendor within 1 working day of sales confirmation — correct specifications, price, delivery date, and payment terms
* Take structured weekly follow-ups with vendors on all open POs until material is physically received at Advista — log every follow-up in Weboo
* **Monday Order Status Updates** to the sales executive by 12:00 PM every Monday covering all open orders — real-time, accurate information
* On material receipt: verify material against PO (quantity, specification, make); verify all associated documents (invoice, test report, calibration certificate) on the same day
* Ensure received material is inspected for damage and repacked securely before dispatch
* Arrange appropriate courier or transport for dispatch as per client requirement and urgency — within committed dispatch date and approved cost limits
* **Client Dispatch Intimation** on the same day of dispatch — email + WhatsApp with all three: Tax Invoice, material photographs, and courier docket/tracking number

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA or equivalent graduate; commerce background preferred
* 1 – 3 years of hands-on work experience in accounts and/or purchase in an engineering, manufacturing, or industrial trading company
* Biziverse ERP — training provided on joining; strong preference for candidates with any ERP/accounting software background; basic accounting concepts (journal entries, GST invoicing) are mandatory
* Microsoft Excel and Word — working proficiency; able to maintain registers, prepare statements, and format documents
* Basic working knowledge of GST (invoice format, HSN codes, GSTR-1 data); TDS awareness is a plus
* Comfortable with vendor communication over email and WhatsApp in a professional manner
* Marathi and Hindi fluency required; basic written English for email communication

**Key Behavioural Attributes We Value**

* **Ownership mindset:** treats both accounts and purchase as their own department — does not wait to be reminded
* **Accuracy over speed:** checks before submitting; zero tolerance for invoice errors or wrong POs
* **Discipline with deadlines:** Monday updates go out on Monday; invoices go out on dispatch day; no exceptions
* **Proactive communication:** updates the manager on delays before the manager asks
* **Adaptability:** comfortable switching between accounts work in the morning and vendor follow-ups in the afternoon — this is a multi-task role
* **Growth orientation:** willing to learn new tools (Weboo, Biziverse CRM) and take on additional responsibilities as the company grows

**This Role Is NOT a Fit If You...**

* Have only done data entry with no ownership of the full accounts or purchase cycle
* Are looking for a work-from-home or flexible-hours arrangement — this is a full-time on-site role
* Are not comfortable with direct vendor and client communication
* Expect a large team and dedicated IT support — we are a lean, growing company

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹10,227.51 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

title: Principal Enablement Experience Consultant - India
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Principal Enablement Experience Consultant - India**
======================================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

Job Description | Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experience

Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University

  

**About Cornerstone:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

  

**About the role:**

Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys.

As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You’ll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you’ll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal.

This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You’ll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You’ll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone’s own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.

The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company’s future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.

This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.

  

**Scope and Decision Rights:**

* **You own:** Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
* **You partner on:** enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).
  

**In this role, you will…**

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management*

* Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
* Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
* Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
* Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
* Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.

*Architecture & Standards*

* Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
* Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
* Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
* Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.

*AI-Powered Experiences*

* Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
* Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
* Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.
* Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems.

*Integration & Execution*

* Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal.
* Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management.
* Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team.
* Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use.
* Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards.

*Partnership & Leadership*

* Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes.
* Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT.
* Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product.
* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.
  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **First 30-60 days:** current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway.
* **By 6 months:** unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience’s needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics.
* **By 9-12 months:** single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale.
* **Ongoing measures:** front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools.
* Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes.
* Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics.
* A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
* Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI).
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar.
* AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost.
* Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level.
* Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day.
  

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect.
* Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data.
* Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs.
* Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms.
* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect).
  

**How You Work:**

* **Customer obsessed:** you start from the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* **Innovate and transform:** you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don’t earn their place.
* **Proactive leadership:** you see the problem and act before you’re asked.
* **Get it done:** you ship, measure, and iterate.
* **Forward looking:** you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been.
* **AI native:** you use AI every day to rethink your own work, not just to speed it up.
* **Get uncomfortable to succeed:** you take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.
  

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
